description: Set a worker's recurring calendar, as the labor resources screen's recurring editor does: the local days it covers (firstDate to lastDate, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 365 days), weekly shift and break windows on the local clock, and dated exceptions (one-off shifts, breaks, absences and authorized overtime, as instants with an offset). It replaces the worker's whole calendar; inside the covered days time not on a shift is off duty, outside them capacity is unknown, and commitments check crews against it. The time zone defaults to the account's. Admin; operator credentials only. Preview first; the in-app assistant gets a confirm card.

exceptions.description: Dated exceptions, at most 500: start and end (ISO 8601 with an offset or Z) and kind (shift, break, absence or overtime).

firstDate.description: The first local day the calendar covers, YYYY-MM-DD.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lastDate.description: The last local day the calendar covers, YYYY-MM-DD.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

repeatedTimePolicy.description: When the clock repeats an hour (daylight saving ends): earlier (default) or later.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, e.g. America/Denver; defaults to the account's.

weeklyWindows.description: Weekly windows, at most 50: day (one weekday, monday … sunday; add a window for each further day), start and end on the local clock (HH:mm; an end at or before the start runs past midnight), and kind (shift, the default, or break).

worker.description: The worker, by id or full name.

name: set_labor_calendar
title: Set Labor Calendar
